short: Closed-loop sEEG word synthesis (M06) and audible-to-imagined transfer (M04) are standard; one participant; imagined output lacks word identification and an imagery control (M12 behind).
position: The paper closes the loop from sEEG to whole-word spectral synthesis (M06) and runs an audible-trained decoder unchanged on whispered and imagined words (M04). Both are standard: closed-loop synthesis had 5 prior closed loops across intracortical, articulography and EEG recordings [@guenther2009; @bocquelet2016; @brumberg2018], and overt-to-covert transfer follows Martin et al. [@martin2014]; one participant in one session gives no repetition. The evaluation is behind the group's own earlier four-option listener test [@herff2019]: imagined output is scored only by DTW correlation (0.32 against a 0.17 null from a separate non-speech session), so nothing shows that it carries the imagined word or separates imagery from prompt reading.
